student_profile: Domestic student, GPA 3.8, enrolling full-time PhD at RMIT, no prior research degree
natural_language_query: Am I eligible for the RTP Stipend Scholarship at RMIT?
critical_clause: To be eligible for a scholarship under these Terms and Conditions a student must be eligible to enrol or currently be enrolled in an HDR program at RMIT

student_profile: International student, Masters by Research, wants to study part-time due to full-time job
natural_language_query: Can I get a part-time RTP stipend if I work full-time?
critical_clause: Work commitments cannot be accepted as grounds for converting a stipend scholarship to part-time

student_profile: Domestic student, has primary carer responsibilities for preschool child, PhD enrolment
natural_language_query: I am a single parent with a 3-year-old. Can I study part-time with RTP?
critical_clause: having primary carer responsibilities for a pre-school child

student_profile: Student previously held an RTP Stipend at another uni for 8 months then withdrew
natural_language_query: I had an RTP at Monash for 8 months but withdrew. Can I get another at RMIT?
critical_clause: must not have previously held a Commonwealth-funded postgraduate research scholarship (unless it was terminated within six months of payments commencing)

student_profile: Student already holds an RTP Fees Offset, wants RTP Stipend too
natural_language_query: I have an RTP Fees Offset. Can I also get the RTP Stipend?
critical_clause: RTP Stipend Scholarships provide a living allowance... RTP Fees Offset Scholarships cover the tuition fees

student_profile: Student has consumed 3.5 EFTSL in a PhD program at previous university, now transferring to RMIT
natural_language_query: I have used 3.5 years of PhD funding at my old uni. Can I transfer my scholarship to RMIT?
critical_clause: must not have consumed more than 3.0 Equivalent Full-time Study Load (EFTSL) in a PhD program prior to the scholarship commencement

student_profile: Australian citizen already holds a PhD, wants to do a second PhD at RMIT
natural_language_query: I have a PhD in Physics but want to do another in Engineering. Can I get RTP?
critical_clause: unless they are an Australian and New Zealand citizen undertaking a second PhD in which case they are eligible for the RTP Fee Offset scholarship only

student_profile: Student applying for VCPS, completed a Masters by Research 2 years ago
natural_language_query: I finished my Masters by Research 2 years ago. Can I apply for the Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship?
critical_clause: For the Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship (VCPS) the applicant must not have undertaken any prior higher degree by research candidature in the last three years

student_profile: International student with disability, needs part-time study
natural_language_query: I have a medical condition that limits my capacity to study full-time. Can I get part-time RTP?
critical_clause: having a medical condition that limits the capacity to undertake full-time study (supported by medical certification from a qualified healthcare practitioner)

student_profile: Student wants to defer scholarship start to next calendar year
natural_language_query: Can I defer my scholarship start date to next year?
critical_clause: Commencement cannot be deferred into the following calendar year

student_profile: Domestic PhD student, earns $35,000/year from part-time job unrelated to study
natural_language_query: I work part-time earning $35k/year at a cafe. Will this affect my RTP stipend?
critical_clause: Income unrelated to the candidate's course of study... is not to be taken into account

student_profile: Domestic PhD student, earns $40,000/year from research assistant job in their field
natural_language_query: I earn $40k as an RA in my supervisor's lab. Can I still get RTP stipend?
critical_clause: must not be receiving income from another source to support that candidate's general living costs... if that income is greater than 75 percent of that candidate's RTP stipend rate

student_profile: Student transferring TO RMIT from another uni with 1.5 years RTP already used
natural_language_query: I am transferring to RMIT with 1.5 years of RTP used. What happens?
critical_clause: RMIT commits to providing the equivalent RTP Scholarship at RMIT rates for the remaining standard duration of the scholarship in the new program

student_profile: Student transferring AWAY from RMIT to another uni
natural_language_query: I want to transfer my RTP to Melbourne Uni. Can I?
critical_clause: RTP scholarship support provided through RMIT will cease upon cancellation of enrolment at RMIT

student_profile: Student on RTP stipend wants to do a 3-month industry internship with $5k stipend
natural_language_query: Can I do an industry internship while on RTP?
critical_clause: there will be no impact on the duration or level or support provided through an RTP fees offset scholarship

student_profile: Student on RTP stipend wants to do a 3-month industry internship with $25k salary
natural_language_query: Can I do a paid internship earning $25k while on RTP stipend?
critical_clause: RTP Stipend Scholarship (RSS) conditions apply if the candidate receives an income associated with the activity

student_profile: Student's stipend was terminated for misconduct 6 months ago
natural_language_query: My stipend was terminated for plagiarism. Can I reapply?
critical_clause: If a research stipend is terminated it cannot be re-activated unless the termination occurred in error

student_profile: Student has unsatisfactory academic progress after 2 years
natural_language_query: My progress review was unsatisfactory. Will I lose my RTP?
critical_clause: RMIT can terminate an RTP fees offset based on a candidate having established unsatisfactory academic progress

student_profile: International student on RTP wants to transfer scholarship to home country uni
natural_language_query: I want to move back home and continue my PhD there. Can I keep RTP?
critical_clause: RTP scholarship support provided through RMIT will cease upon cancellation of enrolment at RMIT

student_profile: Student upgrading from Masters by Research to PhD at RMIT
natural_language_query: I am upgrading from MRes to PhD. Will my scholarship duration change?
critical_clause: candidates who upgrade from a research master's to a research doctorate degree will have their scholarship extended to the standard duration of a PhD scholarship

student_profile: PhD awarded March 2021, applying for DECRA 2027
natural_language_query: I got my PhD in March 2021. Can I apply for DECRA?
critical_clause: have an award of PhD date on, or after the grant opportunity eligibility dates listed on the ARC website

student_profile: PhD awarded February 2021, no career interruptions
natural_language_query: I got my PhD in February 2021. Am I eligible for DECRA?
critical_clause: have an award of PhD date on, or after the grant opportunity eligibility dates listed on the ARC website

student_profile: PhD awarded January 2019, took 2 years parental leave
natural_language_query: I got my PhD in 2019 but took 2 years off for kids. Can I apply for DECRA?
critical_clause: have an award of PhD date together with an allowable period of career interruption that would be commensurate with an award of PhD date on or after the grant opportunity eligibility dates

student_profile: Applied for DECRA twice before, unsuccessful both times
natural_language_query: I have applied for DECRA twice before and was rejected. Can I apply again?
critical_clause: An individual who has been nominated for a DECRA on two previous occasions... is not eligible to apply for another DECRA. This includes applications that were withdrawn

student_profile: Applied for DECRA once before, withdrew after closing date
natural_language_query: I applied once before but withdrew. Can I apply again?
critical_clause: An individual who has been nominated for a DECRA on two previous occasions... is not eligible

student_profile: Holds two active Discovery Projects as CI, wants to apply for DECRA
natural_language_query: I am a CI on two Discovery Projects. Can I also get a DECRA?
critical_clause: A named participant can be concurrently funded through the Discovery Program for a maximum of: two projects as a Chief Investigator (CI); or one ARC Fellowship and one project as a CI

student_profile: International researcher, not employed at Australian uni, wants Future Fellowship
natural_language_query: I am a professor in the UK. Can I apply for a Future Fellowship?
critical_clause: You may apply for an Australian Laureate Fellowship on behalf of an Australian or international researcher

student_profile: Future Fellowship candidate is Academic Level C
natural_language_query: I am a Level C academic. What Future Fellowship level do I apply for?
critical_clause: a researcher who is currently an Academic Level C must apply for a Future Fellowship Level 2

student_profile: Previous recipient of Future Fellowship, wants another one
natural_language_query: I held a Future Fellowship 5 years ago. Can I apply again?
critical_clause: A previous recipient of a Future Fellowship is not eligible to apply for another Future Fellowship

student_profile: Nominated for Future Fellowship 3 times previously over eligible period
natural_language_query: I have been nominated for Future Fellowship 3 times before. Can I apply again?
critical_clause: An individual who has been nominated for a Future Fellowship on three previous occasions... is not eligible to apply for another Future Fellowship
